title: Table 1.1 Application of the R-Codes development standards

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 1 - Operation of the Code.pdf

footnote_text: Any dwellings in a mixed use development are considered to be multiple dwellings and the relevant Chapter and part applies.

rows.note: Table 1.1 prints 'all density codes (R2-R80; R100-SL; R-AC)'; Chapter 2 applies the R80 standards to R100, R160 and LR/MR/HR (register CH1-06).
rows.text: Chapter 2 Single Houses: Includes all provisions applicable to single houses across all density codes (R2-R80; R100-SL; R-AC).

rows.note: Same R100/R160 presentational gap as single houses (CH1-07).
rows.text: Chapter 3 Grouped Dwellings: Includes all provisions applicable to grouped dwellings across all density codes (R2-R80; R100-SL; R-AC (LR, MR and HR)).
Chapter 4 Multiple Dwellings, Part 1: Includes provisions applicable to multiple dwellings (including the dwelling component of mixed use development) in areas coded R10 to R60.

rows.note: Chapter 1B: entirely performance-based. Part 1 intro says R80-R160 and LR, MR, HR; Table 1.1 says R80 and above and R-AC (CH1-09). Table 1.1 prints only 'R80+ & R-AC (LR, MR and HR)'; R-PA and R-AC0..R-AC4 in the coding list are engine aliases, not printed on the page.
rows.text: Chapter 4 Multiple Dwellings, Part 2: Includes provisions applicable to multiple dwellings (including the dwelling component of mixed use development) in areas coded R80+ & R-AC (LR, MR and HR).

rows.note: R100-SL for multiple dwellings is addressed by neither Part 1 nor Part 2 of Chapter 4 (CH1-09).
rows.text: (no entry) Table 1.1 Chapter 4 covers R10 to R60 (Part 1) and R80+ & R-AC (Part 2); R100-SL is not named for multiple dwellings.

rows.note: Multiple dwellings below R10 are not provided for (CH1-08).
rows.text: (no entry) Table 1.1 Chapter 4 Part 1 begins at R10.
